description: Dedicated 10-question evaluation set for Day 24 RAG autotest. Replaces the legacy external questions.json. Includes STLB-OK1 -> revit-703 only (positive, source=confluence_html), neighbouring server columns revit-702/704 (positive, source=confluence_html), Revit version question (no inference from 'Projects 2022'), no-evidence / ambiguity cases (no expected_source — abstention expected), and KB positive questions (Confluence KB page 'Не удалось построить ленту' / 'Программа Autodesk Revit не работает', and PDF page 3 'RSN.ini'). HTML table questions use confluence_html (matches actual chunk source emitted by confluence_html.py), not legacy 'confluence'. Negative no-evidence cases intentionally have no expected_source because abstention answers produce no source match.
